decisions.choice: a prayer: may grace and peace be multiplied to you
decisions.reason: πληθυνθείη is a wish, a form Greek uses for prayers. The same words open 1 Peter (1 Peter 1:2) and Jude 2: may grace and peace grow and increase in you.

decisions.choice: knowledge: knowing God and Jesus personally, which grows
decisions.reason: ἐπιγνώσει is a key word of this letter (1:3; 1:8; 2:20). It is the knowledge that comes from being called by God and joined to him, not information alone. Grace and peace grow "in" it, as the readers come to know God better. The letter ends on the same note: "grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord" (3:18).

decisions.choice: two persons: God, and Jesus our Lord
decisions.reason: Here each name has its own article and they are joined by "and", so God the Father and Jesus are named side by side. This is a different pattern from 1:1, where one article joins "God" and "Savior" (1:1 m3).

decisions.choice: May you have grace and peace in ever greater measure (B); I pray that you will have more and more grace and peace (R)
alternatives: Grace and peace be multiplied to you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the greeting a plain prayer, as Philippians 1:2 and Colossians 1:2 do at Readable.

decisions.choice: conocimiento (L); conocer (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Conocimiento" is the letter's word for knowing God and Christ (m2), as in Colossians; the same word returns in 1:3 and 1:8. Balanced and Readable use the verb "conocer", which says that the readers know a person.

decisions.choice: ujuzi (L, B); kumjua Mungu na kumjua Yesu (R)
decisions.reason: "Ujuzi" is the letter's word for this knowledge (m2), as in Colossians. Readable uses the verb and repeats it for each person, because one object marker "-m-" cannot stand for God and Jesus together.

decisions.choice: "앎" (L) and "알아 가다" (B, R) for knowing God (epignosis), through the letter; "지식" for the other word for knowledge (1:5-6; 3:18)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this knowledge as knowing God and Jesus personally, a knowing that grows. Korean "앎" and the verb "알다" keep that personal sense; "지식" is kept for the other noun, so the two words stay apart as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: "sự hiểu biết" (L), "nhận biết", "biết rõ" (B, R) for knowledge, through the letter
decisions.reason: The knowledge is knowing God and Jesus personally, which grows (m2). The Vietnamese Colossians keeps "sự hiểu biết" for this word (1:9-10) and "tri thức" for knowledge as information.

source.text: Ὡς πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ, δι’ ὧν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται, ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως, ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Since all things to us of the divine power of him, the [things] toward life and godliness, having been given through the knowledge of the [one] having called us by own glory and excellence, \v 4 through which the precious and very great to us promises he has given, so that through these you may become of divine sharers nature, having escaped the in the world in desire decay.

en.L: Since {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} divine power has given to us all that is for life and godliness, through the knowledge of the one who called us by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own glory and excellence, \v 4 through which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given to us the precious and surpassingly great promises, so that through them you may become sharers of [the] divine nature, having escaped the decay [that is] in the world by desire.
en.B: By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} divine power we have been given every gift that leads to life and godliness, through knowing the one who called us by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own glory and goodness. \v 4 Through these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises, precious and greater than any other, so that through them you may come to share in the divine nature, now that you have escaped the decay that desire has brought into the world.
en.R: His power as God has given us every gift we need to live and to live in a godly way. These gifts come as we know the one who called us by showing us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own glory and goodness. \v 4 Through that glory and goodness {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises, which are precious and very great. Through these promises you can come to share in God's own nature. You have already escaped from the ruin that evil desires bring into the world.

es.L: Puesto que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} divino poder nos ha dado todo lo que [conduce] a [la] vida y [a la] piedad, por medio del conocimiento del que nos llamó por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia gloria y excelencia, \v 4 por medio de las cuales {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos ha dado las promesas preciosas y sumamente grandes, para que por medio de ellas {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a ser partícipes de [la] naturaleza divina, habiendo escapado de la corrupción [que hay] en el mundo por [el] deseo.
es.B: Por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder divino se nos ha dado todo lo que conduce a la vida y a la piedad, por medio del conocimiento de aquel que nos llamó por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia gloria y bondad. \v 4 Por medio de ellas {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos ha dado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas, preciosas y mayores que ninguna otra, para que por medio de esas promesas {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a participar de la naturaleza divina, ya que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escapado de la corrupción que el deseo ha traído al mundo.
es.R: Su poder como Dios nos ha dado todo lo que necesitamos para vivir, y para vivir como a Dios le agrada. Estos dones nos llegan al conocer a aquel que nos llamó mostrándonos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia gloria y bondad. \v 4 Por medio de esa gloria y bondad, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos ha dado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas, que son preciosas y muy grandes. Por medio de estas promesas {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} llegar a participar de la naturaleza misma de Dios. {{plural_you:Ustedes ya han|Vosotros ya habéis}} escapado de la ruina que los malos deseos traen al mundo.

sw.L: Kwa kuwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} za kimungu zimetupa vitu vyote [vinavyohusu] uzima na utauwa, kupitia ujuzi wa yule aliyetuita kwa utukufu na ubora {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, \v 4 kupitia hivyo ametupa ahadi za thamani zilizo kuu kuliko zote, ili kupitia hizo mpate kuwa washiriki wa asili ya kimungu, mkiwa mmeuepuka uharibifu ulio katika ulimwengu kwa tamaa.
sw.B: Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} za kimungu tumepewa kila kipawa kinachoongoza kwenye uzima na utauwa, kupitia kumjua yule aliyetuita kwa utukufu na wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. \v 4 Kupitia hivyo ametupa ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, zenye thamani na kuu kuliko nyingine zote, ili kupitia ahadi hizo mpate kushiriki asili ya kimungu, kwa kuwa mmeuepuka uharibifu ambao tamaa imeuleta ulimwenguni.
sw.R: Nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kama Mungu zimetupa kila kipawa tunachohitaji ili tuishi, na tuishi maisha yanayompendeza Mungu. Vipawa hivi vinatujia tunapomjua yule aliyetuita kwa kutuonyesha utukufu na wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. \v 4 Kupitia utukufu na wema huo ametupa ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, zenye thamani na kubwa sana. Kupitia ahadi hizo mnaweza kushiriki asili ya Mungu mwenyewe. Tayari mmeuepuka uharibifu ambao tamaa mbaya huleta ulimwenguni.

fr.L: Puisque {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} divine puissance nous a donné tout ce qui [concerne] la vie et la piété, par la connaissance de celui qui nous a appelés par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre gloire et [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] vertu, \v 4 par lesquelles {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné les précieuses et très grandes promesses, afin que par elles vous deveniez participants de [la] nature divine, ayant échappé à la corruption [qui est] dans le monde par la convoitise.
fr.B: Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} divine puissance, nous avons reçu tout ce qui conduit à la vie et à la piété, en connaissant celui qui nous a appelés par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre gloire et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté. \v 4 Par elles, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses, précieuses et plus grandes que toutes les autres, afin que, grâce à ces promesses, vous ayez part à la nature divine, maintenant que vous avez échappé à la corruption que le désir a introduite dans le monde.
fr.R: Sa puissance divine nous a donné tout ce dont nous avons besoin pour vivre, et pour vivre dans le respect de Dieu. Ces dons nous viennent quand nous connaissons celui qui nous a appelés en nous montrant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre gloire et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté. \v 4 Par cette gloire et cette bonté, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses, qui sont précieuses et très grandes. Grâce à ces promesses, vous pouvez avoir part à la nature même de Dieu. Vous avez déjà échappé à la ruine que les mauvais désirs apportent dans le monde.

ko.L: 그분의 신적인 능력이, 그분 자신의 영광과 덕으로 우리를 부르신 분을 아는 앎을 통하여, 생명과 경건에 관한 모든 것을 우리에게 주셨으니, \v 4 그것들을 통하여 그분은 귀하고 지극히 큰 약속들을 우리에게 주셨습니다. 이는 그 약속들을 통하여, 여러분이 세상에서 욕망 때문에 생긴 썩음을 피하여, 신적인 본성에 참여하는 사람이 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그분은 신적인 능력으로 생명과 경건에 이르게 하는 모든 것을 우리에게 주셨습니다. 그것은 그분 자신의 영광과 선하심으로 우리를 부르신 분을 앎으로써 주어졌습니다. \v 4 그 영광과 선하심으로 그분은 귀하고 무엇보다 큰 약속들을 우리에게 주셨습니다. 그것은 이제 여러분이 욕망 때문에 세상에 들어온 썩음에서 벗어났으니, 그 약속들을 통해 신적인 본성에 참여하게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님이신 그분의 능력은 우리가 살아가는 데 필요한 모든 것, 하나님을 경외하며 사는 데 필요한 모든 것을 선물로 주셨습니다. 이 선물들은 우리가 그분을 알아 갈 때 주어집니다. 그분은 그분 자신의 영광과 선하심을 보여 주셔서 우리를 부르셨습니다. \v 4 그 영광과 선하심으로 그분은 귀하고 아주 큰 약속들을 우리에게 주셨습니다. 이 약속들을 통해 여러분은 하나님 자신의 본성을 함께 나누어 가질 수 있습니다. 여러분은 악한 욕망이 세상에 가져오는 멸망에서 이미 벗어났습니다.

vi.L: Vì quyền năng thiên thượng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta mọi điều thuộc về sự sống và sự tin kính, qua sự hiểu biết Đấng đã gọi chúng ta bởi vinh quang và đức hạnh của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 4 nhờ đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta những lời hứa quý báu và vô cùng lớn lao, để nhờ những lời hứa ấy anh chị em được dự phần bản tính thiên thượng, khi đã thoát khỏi sự hư nát [đang có] trong thế gian do dục vọng.
vi.B: Bởi quyền năng thiên thượng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng ta đã được ban cho mọi điều cần cho sự sống và sự tin kính, qua sự nhận biết Đấng đã gọi chúng ta bởi vinh quang và lòng nhân đức của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 4 Qua những điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta những lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những lời hứa quý báu và lớn lao hơn hết, để nhờ đó anh chị em được dự phần vào bản tính thiên thượng, vì anh chị em đã thoát khỏi sự hư nát mà dục vọng đã đem vào thế gian.
vi.R: Quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta mọi điều chúng ta cần để sống và sống cách tin kính. Chúng ta nhận được những điều ấy khi biết Đấng đã kêu gọi chúng ta bằng cách bày tỏ cho chúng ta vinh quang và sự tốt lành của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 4 Qua vinh quang và sự tốt lành ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho chúng ta những lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những lời hứa quý báu và rất lớn lao. Nhờ những lời hứa ấy, anh chị em có thể được dự phần vào chính bản tính của Đức Chúa Trời. Anh chị em đã thoát khỏi sự hủy hoại mà những ham muốn xấu xa đem vào thế gian.

pt.L: Visto que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} divino poder nos deu tudo o que [conduz] à vida e à piedade, por meio do conhecimento daquele que nos chamou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria glória e excelência, \v 4 pelas quais {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos deu as preciosas e grandíssimas promessas, para que por meio delas vocês se tornem participantes da natureza divina, tendo escapado da corrupção [que há] no mundo pelo desejo.
pt.B: Pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder divino, recebemos todos os dons que conduzem à vida e à devoção a Deus, por conhecermos aquele que nos chamou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria glória e bondade. \v 4 Por elas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos deu as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} promessas, preciosas e maiores que quaisquer outras, para que, por meio dessas promessas, vocês venham a participar da natureza divina, agora que escaparam da corrupção que o desejo trouxe ao mundo.
pt.R: O poder {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, que é o poder de Deus, nos deu todos os dons de que precisamos para viver e para viver como Deus quer. Esses dons vêm à medida que conhecemos aquele que nos chamou ao nos mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria glória e bondade. \v 4 Por meio dessa glória e bondade, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos deu as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} promessas, que são preciosas e muito grandes. Por meio dessas promessas, vocês podem vir a participar da própria natureza de Deus. Vocês já escaparam da ruína que os maus desejos trazem ao mundo.

am.L: መለኮታዊ ኃይሉ በገዛ ክብሩና በበጎነቱ የጠራንን በማወቅ በኩል ለሕይወትና ለእግዚአብሔር ማደር የሚያስፈልገውን ሁሉ ስለ ሰጠን፣ \v 4 በእነዚህም በኩል ክቡርና እጅግ ታላቅ የሆኑትን የተስፋ ቃሎች ሰጥቶናል፤ ይህም በእነዚህ በኩል በምኞት ምክንያት በዓለም ካለው መበስበስ አምልጣችሁ የመለኮታዊ ባሕርይ ተካፋዮች እንድትሆኑ ነው።
am.B: በመለኮታዊ ኃይሉ በገዛ ክብሩና በበጎነቱ የጠራንን በማወቅ ወደ ሕይወትና ለእግዚአብሔር ወደ ያደረ ሕይወት የሚመራ ስጦታ ሁሉ ተሰጥቶናል። \v 4 በእነዚህም ክቡርና ከሁሉ የሚበልጡ የተስፋ ቃሎቹን ሰጥቶናል፤ ይህም ምኞት ወደ ዓለም ካመጣው መበስበስ አሁን ስላመለጣችሁ በእነርሱ በኩል የመለኮታዊ ባሕርይ ተካፋዮች እንድትሆኑ ነው።
am.R: እንደ አምላክ ያለው ኃይሉ ለመኖርና እግዚአብሔርን አክብረን ለመኖር የሚያስፈልገንን ስጦታ ሁሉ ሰጥቶናል። እነዚህ ስጦታዎች የሚመጡት የራሱን ክብርና በጎነት በማሳየት የጠራንን ስናውቅ ነው። \v 4 በዚያ ክብርና በጎነት የተስፋ ቃሎቹን ሰጥቶናል፤ እነዚህም ክቡርና እጅግ ታላቅ ናቸው። በእነዚህ የተስፋ ቃሎች የእግዚአብሔርን ባሕርይ ልትካፈሉ ትችላላችሁ። ክፉ ምኞት ወደ ዓለም ከሚያመጣው ጥፋት አስቀድማችሁ አምልጣችኋል።

decisions.choice: since: verses 3-4 give the ground for the call to effort in verses 5-7
alternatives: verses 3-4 complete the greeting: grace and peace grow just as his power has given everything (1:2)
decisions.reason: Ὡς with the participle δεδωρημένης means "since" or "seeing that". The clause has no main verb of its own. Verse 5 begins "for this very reason", which most naturally points back to what God has given here: because he has given everything, make every effort. It can also be read as continuing verse 2. The SBLGNT ends the sentence at the end of verse 4, and this record follows it.

decisions.choice: his ... the one who called us: most likely Jesus Christ, though God the Father may be meant
decisions.reason: The last person named is "Jesus our Lord" (1:2), and the letter speaks of Christ's own power and majesty (1:16) and calls him God (1:1). Elsewhere it is usually God the Father who calls (1 Peter 1:15; 5:10). The Greek does not name him, and the decision is left open.

decisions.choice: divine power; godliness: God's own power, and a life of reverence and devotion to God
decisions.reason: θείας means belonging to God, of God's own kind. εὐσέβειαν means reverence for God shown in how one lives; it comes again in 1:6 and 3:11. "Life and godliness" probably means the new life believers have and the godly way of living that goes with it.

decisions.choice: by his own glory and excellence: the means by which he called us
alternatives: to his own glory and excellence: the goal of the call
decisions.reason: The two nouns are dative with no preposition, which most naturally gives the means: he called us by showing his glory and excellence. Glory is his splendor as God; ἀρετῇ is excellence or goodness, often the excellent deeds that show someone's character (compare 1 Peter 2:9). Some manuscripts read "through glory and excellence", which comes to the same thing.

decisions.choice: sharers of the divine nature: believers come to share God's own life, above all his freedom from decay and death, through his promises
alternatives: become divine in being, losing the difference between God and human beings
fellowship with God only, with no change in the believer
decisions.reason: κοινωνοὶ means a partner or sharer (1 Peter 5:1 uses it of sharing in glory). The phrase "divine nature" was common in Greek thought, and Peter uses the readers' own language. The contrast in the same sentence explains it: they escape the decay of the world, and share instead in what God is, imperishable and holy (compare 1:11; 1 Peter 1:4, 1:23). The promises point to Christ's coming (3:4, 3:13), so this sharing has begun and is completed then. The verse does not say that believers stop being creatures. How far the phrase reaches has been understood in different ways in the history of the church; the Eastern churches build their teaching on deification partly on it.

decisions.choice: the decay that is in the world through desire: the ruin and death that wrong desire brings
decisions.reason: φθορᾶς means decay, ruin, corruption: both the rotting of what dies and the moral ruin of a life (2:12, 2:19 use the same word). ἐπιθυμίᾳ is desire, here desire set against God. "World" is the world of people turned away from God, the setting of this decay (2:20).

decisions.choice: through which: through his glory and excellence
alternatives: through all that has been given
decisions.reason: ὧν is plural, so it points back to "glory and excellence", the nearest plural pair. It may also gather up everything in verse 3.

decisions.choice: goodness
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "excellence" here and in 1:5. Balanced and Readable say "goodness", a word readers use, both for God here and for the believer in 1:5, so the link between the two verses remains.

decisions.choice: By his divine power we have been given ... (B); His power as God has given us ... (R)
alternatives: Since his divine power has given us ...
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "Since", which leaves the sentence waiting for verse 5 (m1). Balanced and Readable make the verses full sentences of their own; "For this very reason" in verse 5 still links them.

decisions.choice: called us by showing us his own glory and goodness; God's own nature; evil desires
decisions.reason: Readable explains the means of the call (m4), uses "God's own nature" for "divine nature" (m5), and says the desires are evil (m6).

decisions.choice: piedad (L, B); vivir como a Dios le agrada (R)
decisions.reason: "Piedad" is the settled word for this letter's reverence for God shown in life (m3); it returns in 1:6-7 and 3:11. Readable says what it means in a phrase, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: utauwa (L, B); maisha yanayompendeza Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Utauwa" is the settled word for godliness (m3) and returns in 1:6-7 and 3:11. Readable says what it means, "a life that pleases God", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ubora (L), wema (B, R); asili ya kimungu
decisions.reason: For ἀρετῇ Literal keeps "ubora" (excellence) and Balanced and Readable say "wema" (goodness), as the English does; 1:5 uses the same words for the believer. For "nature" Swahili "asili" names what a thing is, while "tabia" leans towards behaviour or character.

decisions.choice: la piété (L, B), le respect de Dieu (R); la vertu (L), la bonté (B, R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Piété" is the French word for a life of reverence and devotion to God (meaning decision m3); Readable says it plainly. The second word means moral excellence: "vertu" keeps it at Literal, and Balanced and Readable say "bonté", as the English says "goodness".

decisions.choice: la corruption (L, B); la ruine (R)
decisions.reason: The word means decay and the death it brings (meaning decision m6). French "corruption" has that sense in Bible language, though today it first suggests bribery; Readable says "la ruine".

decisions.choice: "경건" for godliness at every level but Readable ("하나님을 경외하며 사는"), through the letter
decisions.reason: Godliness is a life of reverence and devotion to God (meaning decision). "경건" is the established word, kept for this Greek word alone (James's word for religion is "종교" and "신앙생활"); Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "신적인 본성에 참여하는 사람" (L); "신적인 본성에 참여하다" (B); "하나님 자신의 본성을 함께 나누어 가지다" (R); "썩음" for decay
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as sharing God's own life, above all his freedom from decay and death, and footnotes it. "참여하다" is the current word for sharing in something; "참예" is archaic. "썩음" keeps the picture of decay that is set against God's undying life.

decisions.choice: "sự tin kính", "tin kính" for godliness, through the letter (1:6-7; 3:11)
decisions.reason: Godliness is a life of reverence and devotion to God (m3). "Tin kính" is the established Protestant word for it, and keeps "kính sợ" for the fear of God.

decisions.choice: "thiên thượng" for divine (L, B); "bản tính thiên thượng" for the divine nature
decisions.reason: Divine is what belongs to God himself (m3, m5). "Thiên thượng" says what is of heaven above, of God; "thần thánh" can mean the gods of other religions, and "thiêng liêng" means only sacred. Readable says "God's own nature", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a piedade (L); a devoção a Deus (B); viver como Deus quer (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 1:6-7; 3:11), as in 1 Timothy. "Piedade" is the established word at Literal, but in everyday Brazilian Portuguese it mostly means pity; Balanced says what it is, "devoção a Deus", and Readable describes the life (m3), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a corrupção (L, B); a ruína (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 2:19; in 2:12, of animals killed, the word is "destruição" as in the English). "Corrupção" keeps both senses of the word, the decay of what dies and the moral ruin of a life (m6), as in "o corpo corruptível"; context keeps it from reading as bribery. Readable says "ruína", as the English Readable says "ruin".

decisions.choice: ለእግዚአብሔር ማደር (godliness, L); ለእግዚአብሔር ያደረ ሕይወት (a life devoted to God, B); Readable እግዚአብሔርን ማክበር (honouring God), as in 1 Timothy; the same in 1:6-7 and 3:11
decisions.reason: ማደር is to give oneself over to someone, so ለእግዚአብሔር ማደር is reverence and devotion lived out (m3), the term set for the Pastoral Letters; ሃይማኖተኛነት would mean outward religion.

decisions.choice: መበስበስ (decay, rotting) for the world's corruption, here and in 2:12 and 2:19
decisions.reason: The Greek word is decay leading to death (m6), the opposite of the divine nature believers share; መበስበስ keeps that, where ርኩሰት would make it only a moral stain.

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν, ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην·

records.literal_gloss: And for this very [reason] also, all diligence having brought in, supply in the faith of you the excellence, and in the excellence the knowledge, \v 6 and in the knowledge the self-control, and in the self-control the endurance, and in the endurance the godliness, \v 7 and in the godliness the brotherly affection, and in the brotherly affection the love.

en.L: And for this very [reason], bringing in all diligence, supply in your faith excellence, and in excellence knowledge, \v 6 and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control endurance, and in endurance godliness, \v 7 and in godliness {{gender:affection for brothers and sisters|brotherly affection}}, and in {{gender:affection for brothers and sisters|brotherly affection}} love.
en.B: This is why you must put every effort into this: let your faith provide goodness, and goodness knowledge, \v 6 knowledge self-control, self-control endurance, endurance godliness, \v 7 godliness affection for your fellow believers, and that affection love.
en.R: Because of all this, try as hard as you can to add goodness to your faith. Add knowledge to your goodness. \v 6 Add self-control to your knowledge, and add patient endurance to your self-control. Add a godly life to your endurance. \v 7 Add love for other believers to your godly life, and to all of that, add love for all people.

es.L: Y por esto mismo, aportando todo empeño, {{plural_you:provean|proveed}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe la excelencia, y en la excelencia el entendimiento, \v 6 y en el entendimiento el dominio de sí, y en el dominio de sí la perseverancia, y en la perseverancia la piedad, \v 7 y en la piedad el afecto fraterno, y en el afecto fraterno el amor.
es.B: Por eso mismo, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} empeño en esto: que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe aporte bondad, y la bondad entendimiento, \v 6 el entendimiento dominio de sí, el dominio de sí perseverancia, la perseverancia piedad, \v 7 la piedad afecto por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos en la fe, y ese afecto amor.
es.R: Por todo esto, {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} al máximo por añadir bondad a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} fe. {{plural_you:Añadan|Añadid}} entendimiento a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} bondad. \v 6 {{plural_you:Añadan|Añadid}} dominio de sí mismos a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} entendimiento, y {{plural_you:añadan|añadid}} una paciencia constante a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} dominio de sí mismos. {{plural_you:Añadan|Añadid}} una vida que agrada a Dios a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} paciencia. \v 7 {{plural_you:Añadan|Añadid}} cariño por los demás creyentes a esa vida, y a todo eso {{plural_you:añadan|añadid}} amor por todas las personas.

sw.L: Na kwa sababu hii hasa, mkiweka bidii yote, toeni katika imani yenu ubora, na katika ubora ufahamu, \v 6 na katika ufahamu kujitawala, na katika kujitawala uvumilivu, na katika uvumilivu utauwa, \v 7 na katika utauwa upendo wa kindugu, na katika upendo wa kindugu upendo.
sw.B: Kwa sababu hiyo hiyo, wekeni bidii yote ili imani yenu itoe wema, na wema utoe ufahamu, \v 6 ufahamu utoe kujitawala, kujitawala kutoe uvumilivu, uvumilivu utoe utauwa, \v 7 utauwa utoe kuwapenda waumini wenzenu, na kuwapenda wenzenu kutoe upendo.
sw.R: Kwa sababu ya hayo yote, jitahidini kadiri mwezavyo kuongeza wema kwenye imani yenu. Ongezeni ufahamu kwenye wema wenu. \v 6 Ongezeni kujitawala kwenye ufahamu wenu, na ongezeni uvumilivu kwenye kujitawala kwenu. Ongezeni maisha yanayompendeza Mungu kwenye uvumilivu wenu. \v 7 Ongezeni kuwapenda waumini wenzenu kwenye maisha hayo, na juu ya hayo yote ongezeni upendo kwa watu wote.

fr.L: Et pour cette raison même, y apportant tout [votre] zèle, fournissez dans votre foi la vertu, dans la vertu la connaissance, \v 6 dans la connaissance la maîtrise de soi, dans la maîtrise de soi la persévérance, dans la persévérance la piété, \v 7 dans la piété {{gender:l’affection pour les frères et sœurs|l’affection fraternelle}}, et dans {{gender:l’affection pour les frères et sœurs|l’affection fraternelle}} l’amour.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi vous devez faire tous vos efforts pour que votre foi produise la bonté, la bonté la connaissance, \v 6 la connaissance la maîtrise de soi, la maîtrise de soi la persévérance, la persévérance la piété, \v 7 la piété l’affection pour les autres croyants, et cette affection l’amour.
fr.R: À cause de tout cela, faites tout votre possible pour ajouter la bonté à votre foi. Ajoutez la connaissance à votre bonté. \v 6 Ajoutez la maîtrise de soi à votre connaissance, et la persévérance à votre maîtrise de soi. Ajoutez à votre persévérance une vie de respect envers Dieu. \v 7 Ajoutez à cette vie l’amour pour les autres croyants, et à tout cela, ajoutez l’amour pour tous les gens.

ko.L: 그리고 바로 이 [까닭에] 여러분은 온갖 힘을 다하여 여러분의 믿음에 덕을, 덕에 지식을, \v 6 지식에 절제를, 절제에 인내를, 인내에 경건을, \v 7 경건에 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 우애를, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 우애에 사랑을 더하십시오.
ko.B: 바로 이 때문에 여러분은 힘을 다해 믿음에 선함을, 선함에 지식을 더하고, \v 6 지식에 절제를, 절제에 인내를, 인내에 경건을 더하고, \v 7 경건에 믿음의 식구들을 향한 우애를, 그 우애에 사랑을 더하십시오.
ko.R: 이 모든 것 때문에, 여러분은 있는 힘을 다해 여러분의 믿음에 선한 마음을 더하십시오. 선한 마음에 지식을 더하십시오. \v 6 지식에 자기를 다스리는 힘을 더하고, 그 힘에 끝까지 참고 견디는 힘을 더하십시오. 참고 견디는 힘에 하나님을 경외하는 삶을 더하십시오. \v 7 하나님을 경외하는 삶에 믿음의 식구들을 향한 사랑을 더하고, 이 모든 것에 모든 사람을 향한 사랑을 더하십시오.

vi.L: Và chính vì lẽ đó, anh chị em hãy hết sức chuyên cần, thêm vào đức tin mình đức hạnh, thêm vào đức hạnh sự hiểu biết, \v 6 thêm vào sự hiểu biết sự tiết độ, thêm vào sự tiết độ sự kiên trì, thêm vào sự kiên trì sự tin kính, \v 7 thêm vào sự tin kính tình yêu thương {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, thêm vào tình yêu thương {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} tình yêu thương.
vi.B: Chính vì vậy, anh chị em phải hết sức cố gắng để đức tin của mình đem lại lòng nhân đức, lòng nhân đức đem lại sự hiểu biết, \v 6 sự hiểu biết đem lại sự tiết độ, sự tiết độ đem lại sự kiên trì, sự kiên trì đem lại sự tin kính, \v 7 sự tin kính đem lại lòng yêu mến anh chị em cùng đức tin, và lòng yêu mến ấy đem lại tình yêu thương.
vi.R: Vì tất cả những điều đó, anh chị em hãy cố gắng hết sức để thêm sự tốt lành vào đức tin của mình. Hãy thêm sự hiểu biết vào sự tốt lành. \v 6 Hãy thêm sự tự chủ vào sự hiểu biết, và thêm sự kiên trì vào sự tự chủ. Hãy thêm đời sống tin kính vào sự kiên trì. \v 7 Hãy thêm lòng yêu thương anh chị em tín hữu vào đời sống tin kính, và trên hết mọi điều đó, hãy thêm tình yêu thương dành cho mọi người.

pt.L: E, por isso mesmo, empregando toda a diligência, supram na fé de vocês a excelência, e na excelência o conhecimento, \v 6 e no conhecimento o domínio próprio, e no domínio próprio a perseverança, e na perseverança a piedade, \v 7 e na piedade {{gender:o afeto pelos irmãos e irmãs|o afeto fraterno}}, e {{gender:no afeto pelos irmãos e irmãs|no afeto fraterno}} o amor.
pt.B: Por isso mesmo, façam todo o esforço para que a fé de vocês produza a bondade, e a bondade o conhecimento, \v 6 o conhecimento o domínio próprio, o domínio próprio a perseverança, a perseverança a devoção a Deus, \v 7 a devoção a Deus o afeto pelos irmãos na fé, e esse afeto o amor.
pt.R: Por causa de tudo isso, esforcem-se o máximo que puderem para acrescentar bondade à fé de vocês. Acrescentem conhecimento à bondade. \v 6 Acrescentem domínio próprio ao conhecimento, e acrescentem perseverança ao domínio próprio. Acrescentem uma vida dedicada a Deus à perseverança. \v 7 Acrescentem amor pelos irmãos na fé a essa vida dedicada a Deus e, a tudo isso, acrescentem amor por todas as pessoas.

am.L: ስለዚህም ደግሞ ትጋትን ሁሉ አግብታችሁ በእምነታችሁ ላይ በጎነትን ጨምሩ፤ በበጎነትም ላይ እውቀትን፣ \v 6 በእውቀትም ላይ ራስን መግዛትን፣ ራስን በመግዛትም ላይ ጽናትን፣ በጽናትም ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር ማደርን፣ \v 7 ለእግዚአብሔር በማደርም ላይ {{gender:የወንድሞችና የእኅቶች መዋደድን|የወንድማማች መዋደድን}}፣ {{gender:በወንድሞችና በእኅቶች መዋደድም|በወንድማማች መዋደድም}} ላይ ፍቅርን [ጨምሩ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ትጋትን ሁሉ በዚህ ላይ አድርጉ፤ እምነታችሁ በጎነትን ያስገኝ፤ በጎነትም እውቀትን፣ \v 6 እውቀትም ራስን መግዛትን፣ ራስን መግዛትም ጽናትን፣ ጽናትም ለእግዚአብሔር ያደረ ሕይወትን፣ \v 7 ለእግዚአብሔር ያደረ ሕይወትም ለአማኝ ወገኖቻችሁ መዋደድን፣ ያም መዋደድ ፍቅርን ያስገኝ።
am.R: ከዚህ ሁሉ የተነሣ በእምነታችሁ ላይ በጎነትን ለመጨመር የቻላችሁትን ያህል ጣሩ። በበጎነታችሁ ላይ እውቀትን ጨምሩ። \v 6 በእውቀታችሁ ላይ ራስን መግዛትን፣ ራሳችሁን በመግዛታችሁም ላይ በትዕግሥት መጽናትን ጨምሩ። በጽናታችሁ ላይ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያከብር ኑሮን ጨምሩ። \v 7 እግዚአብሔርን በሚያከብር ኑሮአችሁ ላይ ለሌሎች አማኞች ፍቅርን ጨምሩ፤ በዚህ ሁሉ ላይ ደግሞ ለሰዎች ሁሉ ፍቅርን ጨምሩ።

decisions.choice: for this very reason: because of what God has given (1:3-4)
decisions.reason: αὐτὸ τοῦτο points back: since God's power has given everything for life and godliness, and his promises, the readers must answer with all their effort. God's gift comes first and is the ground of the command.

decisions.choice: supply: provide generously, add one thing to another
decisions.reason: ἐπιχορηγήσατε first meant paying for a chorus in a public festival, and so came to mean providing generously. The same verb returns in 1:11: if the readers supply these things, an entrance into the kingdom "will be richly supplied" to them.

decisions.choice: a chain of qualities: each grows out of the one before and is exercised along with it, from faith to love
alternatives: eight stages to be reached one after another
decisions.reason: Each link is "in" (ἐν) the one before. The figure, where each item picks up the last, was well known in ancient writing (compare Romans 5:3-5). Faith is the root and love the crown; the order shows how they belong together, not a set of steps completed one at a time.

decisions.choice: excellence: moral goodness; knowledge: understanding of God and his will; self-control: mastery of one's desires; endurance: staying firm under pressure; godliness: reverence for God in daily life
decisions.reason: ἀρετήν is the same word used of God in 1:3. γνῶσιν is not the same word as in 1:2-3; it is the practical understanding that grows as one lives with God. ἐγκράτειαν answers the desire of 1:4. ὑπομονήν is patient perseverance, enduring hardship without giving up.

decisions.choice: affection for fellow believers, and love: love within the church's family, then the wider love that God shows
alternatives: two names for the same love
decisions.reason: φιλαδελφίαν is the warm affection of brothers and sisters, used in the New Testament for believers' love for each other (Romans 12:10; 1 Peter 1:22). ἀγάπην is the love God shows in Christ, which gives itself for others. Placing it last suggests a love that reaches beyond the fellowship to all people (compare 1 Thessalonians 3:12).

decisions.choice: {{gender:affection for brothers and sisters|brotherly affection}}
decisions.reason: The word is built on "brother" and means love for the whole family of believers, women and men. "Brotherly affection" remains as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: affection for your fellow believers (B); love for other believers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who the affection is for in words that include everyone, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: let your faith provide goodness, and goodness knowledge ...
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the chain in the Greek order, with "provide" for the verb (m2), and lets each later link share it.

decisions.choice: to all of that, add love for all people
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the final love is for (m5). The Greek says only "love", so this goes a little beyond what is certain.

decisions.choice: afecto fraterno, no setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "fraterno", like "hermanos", already includes sisters when used of the family of believers, so it needs no gender setting. Balanced says "hermanos en la fe" and Readable "los demás creyentes".

decisions.choice: entendimiento
decisions.reason: γνῶσιν here is not the word of 1:2-3 (m4), which Spanish renders "conocimiento". "Entendimiento" keeps the two apart and suits the practical understanding meant here.

decisions.choice: upendo wa kindugu (L); kuwapenda waumini wenzenu (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kindugu" is built on "ndugu", which covers brothers and sisters, so no gender setting is needed. Balanced and Readable use a verb, "to love your fellow believers", so that the last link, "upendo" (love), stands apart from it.

decisions.choice: ufahamu
decisions.reason: γνῶσιν here is not the word of 1:2-3 (m4), which Swahili renders "ujuzi". "Ufahamu" (understanding) keeps the two apart and suits the practical understanding meant here.

decisions.choice: {{gender:l’affection pour les frères et sœurs|l’affection fraternelle}} (L)
decisions.reason: The word is the love within the family of believers (meaning decision m5). As in the English, Literal gives the inclusive wording by default and the traditional "affection fraternelle" as the alternative; both are feminine, so the words around them read correctly either way.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 우애" (L); "믿음의 식구들을 향한 우애" (B); "믿음의 식구들을 향한 사랑" (R); "사랑" for love
decisions.reason: The two words are affection within the church's family and the wider love God shows (meaning decision). Literal keeps the family word with the span used for believers; Balanced and Readable say whom the affection is for, which needs no span. "사랑" stays for the last and greatest word.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" (L), "lòng yêu mến anh chị em cùng đức tin" (B, R) for brotherly affection, and "tình yêu thương" for love (agapē)
decisions.reason: The last two steps are love within the church's family, then the wider love God shows (m5). Literal keeps the family word under the gender setting; Balanced and Readable say fellow believers, as the English does. "Tình yêu thương" is kept for agapē, the last and widest step, as in the Vietnamese John and Colossians.

decisions.choice: "thêm vào ... " repeated (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek chain is "supply in A, B"; Literal repeats "thêm vào" for each step, so the reader sees that each quality is added within the one before (m3).

decisions.choice: supram
decisions.reason: "Suprir" is to provide what is needed, and Literal keeps it so that the link with 1:11 ("será ricamente suprida") stays visible, as m2 notes. Readable says "acrescentem", the plain word for adding one thing to another.

decisions.choice: que a fé de vocês produza a bondade, e a bondade o conhecimento ...
alternatives: acrescentem à fé de vocês a bondade
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the chain in the Greek order, as the English does, and lets one verb serve every link; "produzir" says that each quality grows out of the one before (m3).

decisions.choice: መዋደድ (mutual affection) for the love of brothers and sisters, ፍቅር for the love that crowns the list
decisions.reason: The chain ends with two loves (m5); with ፍቅር for both the last two links would read as the same word, so the family affection is the reciprocal መዋደድ and ፍቅር is kept for the wider love.

source.text: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν·

records.literal_gloss: These things for to you being present and abounding not idle nor unfruitful renders [you] toward the of the Lord of us Jesus Christ knowledge;

en.L: For these things, being yours and abounding, render [you] neither idle nor fruitless toward the knowledge of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: For when these things are yours in growing measure, they will not leave you useless or without fruit in knowing our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: If you have these qualities and they keep growing in you, your life will be useful and full of good fruit as you come to know our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: Porque estas cosas, siendo {{plural_you:suyas|vuestras}} y abundando, no {{plural_you:los|os}} vuelven inactivos ni infructuosos para el conocimiento de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Porque si estas cosas son {{plural_you:suyas|vuestras}} en medida creciente, no {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} inútiles ni sin dar fruto en {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} conocimiento de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} estas cualidades y siguen creciendo en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida será útil y dará mucho fruto bueno a medida que {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} a nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana mambo haya yakiwa nanyi na kuzidi kuwa mengi, hayawafanyi wazembe wala wasiozaa matunda kuelekea ujuzi wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana mambo haya yakiwa yenu kwa wingi unaozidi, hayatawaacha mkiwa bure au bila matunda katika kumjua Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mkiwa na sifa hizi na zikiendelea kukua ndani yenu, maisha yenu yatakuwa ya manufaa na yatazaa matunda mengi mazuri mnapozidi kumjua Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Car ces choses, étant à vous et abondant, ne [vous] rendent ni inactifs ni stériles pour la connaissance de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Car si ces qualités sont en vous et grandissent, elles ne vous laisseront pas inutiles ni sans fruit dans la connaissance de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Si vous avez ces qualités et qu’elles grandissent toujours en vous, votre vie sera utile et pleine de bons fruits, à mesure que vous apprenez à connaître notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

ko.L: 이것들이 여러분에게 있고 넘치면, 여러분이 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 아는 앎에 게으르거나 열매 없는 사람이 되지 않게 할 것입니다.
ko.B: 이런 것들이 여러분에게 있고 점점 더 풍성해지면, 여러분은 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 알아 가는 데 쓸모없거나 열매 없는 사람이 되지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 이런 성품이 여러분에게 있고 계속 자라나면, 여러분은 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 알아 가면서 쓸모 있고 좋은 열매를 많이 맺는 삶을 살게 될 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì những điều này, khi có trong anh chị em và đang gia tăng, khiến [anh chị em] không biếng nhác cũng không thiếu kết quả đối với sự hiểu biết Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Vì khi những điều này có trong anh chị em và ngày càng gia tăng, chúng sẽ không để anh chị em vô dụng hay không kết quả trong sự nhận biết Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Nếu anh chị em có những phẩm chất này và chúng tiếp tục lớn lên trong anh chị em, đời sống anh chị em sẽ có ích và kết nhiều quả tốt khi anh chị em ngày càng biết rõ Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Pois essas coisas, estando em vocês e aumentando, não [os] tornam inativos nem sem fruto para o conhecimento do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Pois, quando essas coisas são de vocês em medida crescente, elas não os deixam inúteis nem sem fruto no conhecimento do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Se vocês têm essas qualidades e elas continuam crescendo em vocês, a vida de vocês será útil e cheia de bons frutos, conforme vocês vão conhecendo o nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.

am.L: እነዚህ ነገሮች በእናንተ ሆነው ቢበዙ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እውቀት ሥራ ፈቶችና ፍሬ ቢሶች አያደርጓችሁምና።
am.B: እነዚህ ነገሮች የእናንተ ሆነው እየበዙ ሲሄዱ ጌታችንን ኢየሱስን {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} በማወቅ የማትጠቅሙና ፍሬ ቢሶች አያደርጓችሁምና።
am.R: እነዚህ ባሕርያት ቢኖሩአችሁና በእናንተ ውስጥ እያደጉ ቢሄዱ ጌታችንን ኢየሱስን {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} ስታውቁ ሕይወታችሁ ጠቃሚና መልካም ፍሬ የሞላበት ይሆናል።

decisions.choice: if these things are yours and growing: a condition
decisions.reason: The two participles, ὑπάρχοντα and πλεονάζοντα, describe the case in which the result follows: having these qualities, and having them more and more.

decisions.choice: not idle nor fruitless: active and bearing fruit
decisions.reason: ἀργοὺς means not working, useless; ἀκάρπους means without fruit, a picture from plants (Mark 4:19; Titus 3:14). Saying "not ... nor" is a way of saying the opposite strongly: such a life is busy and fruitful.

decisions.choice: toward the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ: fruitful in the knowledge of Christ, and growing in it
decisions.reason: εἰς means "toward" or "with respect to". Knowing Christ is where the readers began (1:3) and also where they are going (3:18); these qualities make that knowledge bear fruit.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: your life will be useful and full of good fruit
alternatives: they will not leave you useless or without fruit
decisions.reason: Readable says positively what the double negative means (m2).

source.text: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα, τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων, λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτημάτων.

records.literal_gloss: [The one] to whom for not are present these things, blind he is, being short-sighted, forgetfulness having taken of the cleansing of the former of him sins.

en.L: For whoever does not have these things is blind, nearsighted, having taken on forgetfulness of the cleansing of {{gender:their|his}} past sins.
en.B: Anyone who lacks them cannot see what is ahead and is as good as blind; {{gender:they have|he has}} forgotten that {{gender:they were|he was}} made clean from the sins of the past.
en.R: But people who do not have these qualities cannot see well. They are like someone who is blind. They have forgotten that God washed away the sins they did before.

es.L: Porque quien no tiene estas cosas es ciego, corto de vista, habiendo caído en el olvido de la purificación de sus pecados pasados.
es.B: Quien carece de ellas no ve lo que tiene por delante y es como un ciego; ha olvidado que sus pecados pasados fueron limpiados.
es.R: Pero las personas que no tienen estas cualidades no ven bien. Son como alguien que está ciego. Han olvidado que Dios lavó los pecados que cometieron antes.

sw.L: Kwa maana yeyote asiye na mambo haya ni kipofu, asiyeona mbali, akiwa amepatwa na usahaulifu kuhusu kusafishwa kwa dhambi zake za kale.
sw.B: Mtu asiye na mambo hayo hawezi kuona kilicho mbele yake, naye ni kama kipofu; amesahau kwamba dhambi alizotenda zamani zilioshwa.
sw.R: Lakini watu wasio na sifa hizi hawaoni vizuri. Wako kama mtu aliye kipofu. Wamesahau kwamba Mungu aliziosha dhambi walizotenda zamani.

fr.L: Car celui chez qui ces choses ne sont pas présentes est aveugle, myope, ayant oublié la purification de ses péchés passés.
fr.B: Celui à qui elles manquent ne voit pas ce qui est devant lui et il est comme aveugle ; il a oublié qu’il a été purifié de ses péchés passés.
fr.R: Mais les gens qui n’ont pas ces qualités ne voient pas bien. Ils sont comme quelqu’un qui est aveugle. Ils ont oublié que Dieu a lavé les péchés qu’ils avaient commis avant.

ko.L: 이것들이 없는 사람은 근시여서 눈먼 사람이며, 자기의 옛 죄들이 깨끗하게 된 것을 잊어버린 사람입니다.
ko.B: 이런 것들이 없는 사람은 앞을 내다보지 못하니 눈먼 사람이나 다름없고, 자기가 지난날의 죄에서 깨끗하게 된 것을 잊어버린 사람입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 이런 성품이 없는 사람들은 잘 보지 못합니다. 그들은 눈먼 사람과 같습니다. 그들은 전에 지은 죄를 하나님께서 씻어 주셨다는 것을 잊어버렸습니다.

vi.L: Vì ai không có những điều này là mù lòa, cận thị, đã quên rằng mình đã được làm sạch khỏi tội lỗi cũ.
vi.B: Ai thiếu những điều ấy thì không thấy được điều phía trước và chẳng khác gì người mù; người ấy đã quên rằng mình đã được làm sạch khỏi những tội lỗi trước kia.
vi.R: Nhưng những người không có những phẩm chất này thì không thấy rõ. Họ giống như người mù. Họ đã quên rằng Đức Chúa Trời đã rửa sạch những tội họ đã phạm trước kia.

pt.L: Pois quem não tem essas coisas é cego, míope, tendo se esquecido da purificação dos seus antigos pecados.
pt.B: Quem não as tem não enxerga o que está adiante e é como um cego; esqueceu-se de que foi purificado dos pecados do passado.
pt.R: Mas as pessoas que não têm essas qualidades não conseguem enxergar bem. Elas são como alguém que é cego. Esqueceram que Deus lavou os pecados que elas cometeram antes.

am.L: እነዚህ የሌሉት ግን ዕውር ነው፤ በቅርብ ብቻ የሚያይ ነው፤ የቀድሞ ኃጢአቱን መንጻት ረስቷል።
am.B: እነዚህ የጎደሉት ማንም ሰው ወደ ፊት ያለውን ማየት አይችልም፤ ዕውር ማለት ነው፤ ከቀድሞ ኃጢአቱ መንጻቱን ረስቷል።
am.R: እነዚህ ባሕርያት የሌሏቸው ሰዎች ግን በደንብ ማየት አይችሉም። እንደ ዕውር ናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ቀድሞ ያደረጉትን ኃጢአት እንዳጠበላቸው ረስተዋል።

decisions.choice: blind, nearsighted: unable to see what lies ahead, and so as good as blind
alternatives: blind, shutting the eyes: refusing to see
decisions.reason: μυωπάζων is found only here in the New Testament. It means to be nearsighted, and may also mean to squint or close the eyes. Either way, such a person sees only what is close at hand and has lost sight of the coming kingdom (1:11) and of what Christ has already done.

decisions.choice: the cleansing of past sins: forgiveness received when they first came to Christ
decisions.reason: καθαρισμοῦ is a washing or cleansing. The person's old sins were washed away when they turned to Christ, an event the New Testament links with baptism (Acts 22:16; 1 Corinthians 6:11). To live without these qualities is to act as though that had never happened. λαβὼν λήθην is an idiom: "having taken on forgetfulness", that is, having forgotten.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:they have|he has}}; {{gender:they were|he was}}
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of any person, man or woman, with the masculine forms Greek uses for that. The traditional forms remain as the alternative. Readable uses "people" and "they".

decisions.choice: God washed away the sins they did before
alternatives: the cleansing of their past sins
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who cleanses, which the Greek implies.

decisions.choice: quien ... sus, no setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "quien" and "sus" do not mark gender, so the English setting has nothing to change. The adjectives "ciego" and "corto de vista" are the usual generic masculine for any person, as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: yeyote ... zake, no setting
decisions.reason: Swahili "yeyote", "mtu" and "zake" do not mark gender, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: celui ... ses, il (L, B), without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "{{gender:their|his}}" and "{{gender:they have|he has}}". In French "celui qui" already means anyone, and the "il" and "ses" that refer back to it are ordinary generic French, so no span is needed (French style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: quem ... seus; quem ... foi purificado, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "their" and "his". Portuguese "quem" and "seus" already mean anyone, man or woman, and "purificado" agreeing with "quem" is ordinary generic Portuguese, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: no gender span on the possessive and verbs (ኃጢአቱ, ረስቷል), here and on 'people' in 1:21
alternatives: gender spans, as in the English
decisions.reason: Amharic uses the masculine singular for 'whoever' and ሰው / ሰዎች for human beings, and these already cover men and women, so there are no two wordings for the setting to choose between.

source.text: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι· ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε·

records.literal_gloss: Therefore rather, brothers, be eager firm of you the calling and election to make; these things for doing, not not you will stumble ever;

en.L: Therefore, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, be eager all the more to make your calling and election firm; for doing these things you will never ever stumble.
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, work even harder to make sure that God's call and choice of you stand firm; for as you do these things you will never trip and fall.
en.R: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, try even harder to show that God really has called you and chosen you. If you keep doing these things, you will never fall away.

es.L: Por eso, hermanos, {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} todavía más por afianzar {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} llamamiento y elección; porque haciendo estas cosas nunca jamás {{plural_you:tropezarán|tropezaréis}}.
es.B: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} todavía más empeño en asegurar{{plural_you:se|os}} de que el llamado y la elección de Dios sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} estén firmes; porque si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} estas cosas, nunca {{plural_you:tropezarán|tropezaréis}} ni {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}}.
es.R: Por eso, hermanos, {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} aún más para mostrar que Dios de verdad {{plural_you:los|os}} ha llamado y {{plural_you:los|os}} ha escogido. Si {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} haciendo estas cosas, nunca {{plural_you:se apartarán|os apartaréis}} del camino.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, kazaneni zaidi kuufanya wito na uteule wenu uwe imara; kwa maana mkitenda mambo haya, hamtajikwaa kamwe hata siku moja.
sw.B: Basi, ndugu, jibidisheni hata zaidi kuhakikisha kwamba wito wa Mungu na uteule {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwenu vinasimama imara; kwa maana mkitenda mambo haya hamtajikwaa na kuanguka kamwe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, jitahidini hata zaidi kuonyesha kwamba kweli Mungu amewaita na kuwachagua. Mkiendelea kutenda mambo haya, hamtaanguka na kuiacha imani kamwe.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, empressez-vous d’autant plus d’affermir votre appel et [votre] élection ; car en faisant cela, vous ne trébucherez jamais.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, faites encore plus d’efforts pour que l’appel et le choix de Dieu à votre égard soient bien affermis ; car si vous faites cela, vous ne trébucherez jamais.
fr.R: Alors, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, faites encore plus d’efforts pour montrer que Dieu vous a vraiment appelés et choisis. Si vous continuez à faire ces choses, vous ne tomberez jamais.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분이 부르심을 받은 것과 택하심을 받은 것을 굳게 하는 일에 더욱 힘쓰십시오. 여러분이 이것들을 행하면 결코 넘어지지 않을 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님께서 여러분을 부르시고 택하신 것이 굳게 서도록 더욱 힘쓰십시오. 이런 것들을 행하면 여러분은 결코 걸려 넘어지지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러니 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님께서 여러분을 정말로 부르시고 택하셨다는 것을 여러분의 삶으로 보여 주도록 더욱 힘쓰십시오. 이런 일들을 계속하면 여러분은 결코 넘어지지 않을 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy càng chuyên cần hơn để làm cho sự kêu gọi và sự lựa chọn của anh chị em được vững chắc; vì làm những điều này thì anh chị em sẽ chẳng bao giờ vấp ngã.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy càng cố gắng hơn nữa để làm cho sự kêu gọi và sự lựa chọn của Đức Chúa Trời dành cho anh chị em được vững chắc; vì khi làm những điều này, anh chị em sẽ không bao giờ vấp ngã.
vi.R: Vậy thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy cố gắng hơn nữa để cho thấy rằng Đức Chúa Trời thật đã kêu gọi và chọn anh chị em. Nếu cứ làm những điều này, anh chị em sẽ không bao giờ sa ngã.

pt.L: Por isso, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, sejam ainda mais diligentes em tornar firmes o chamado e a eleição de vocês; pois, fazendo essas coisas, vocês de modo nenhum tropeçarão jamais.
pt.B: Por isso, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, empenhem-se ainda mais para que o chamado e a escolha de Deus em favor de vocês permaneçam firmes; pois, fazendo essas coisas, vocês nunca vão tropeçar e cair.
pt.R: Por isso, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, esforcem-se ainda mais para mostrar que Deus de fato chamou e escolheu vocês. Se continuarem fazendo essas coisas, vocês nunca vão se afastar de Deus.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ መጠራታችሁንና መመረጣችሁን ለማጽናት ይበልጥ ትጉ፤ ይህን ብታደርጉ ከቶ አትሰናከሉምና።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እግዚአብሔር እናንተን መጥራቱና መምረጡ ጸንቶ እንዲቆም ይበልጥ ትጉ፤ ይህን ስታደርጉ ፈጽሞ ተሰናክላችሁ አትወድቁምና።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት እንደ ጠራችሁና እንደ መረጣችሁ ለማሳየት ይበልጥ ጣሩ። ይህን ማድረጋችሁን ብትቀጥሉ ፈጽሞ ከእምነት አትወድቁም።

decisions.choice: make your calling and election firm: confirm by the way you live that God has called and chosen you
alternatives: make God's choice of you happen by your effort
decisions.reason: ποιεῖσθαι is middle, "make for yourselves". God's call and choice come first (1:3); the readers do not create them, but show and secure them by the life of verses 5-7. βεβαίαν means firm, sure, like a legal guarantee.

decisions.choice: calling and election: God's call to faith and his choice of them
decisions.reason: κλῆσιν is God's call (1:3); ἐκλογὴν is his choosing, his election. The two belong together, as "called and chosen" in Revelation 17:14.

decisions.choice: never stumble: never fall so as to be ruined and lose your way to the kingdom
decisions.reason: πταίσητέ can mean to trip, to make a mistake, or to fall to ruin. Here it is the opposite of the rich entrance of 1:11: the person who lives this way will not come to grief. It does not promise that believers will never sin (James 3:2 uses the same verb: "we all stumble in many ways"). The double negative is emphatic: "never, ever".

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is for the whole church, women and men. "Brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: God's call and choice of you (B); show that God really has called you and chosen you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who calls and chooses (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: fall away
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of stumbling is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in Romans and Philippians, Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so adding "y hermanas" would add words the Greek does not have, and no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: Swahili "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in English, the believers are addressed as men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: a eleição (L); a escolha (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "eleição", the theological word for God's choosing (m2); Balanced and Readable say "escolha", the everyday word, since "eleição" in Brazil first suggests voting.

source.text: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: In this way for richly will be supplied to you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of the Lord of us and Savior Jesus Christ.

en.L: For in this way the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} will be richly furnished for you.
en.B: This is how you will be given a full and generous welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: Then God will welcome you with great honor into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: Porque así se {{plural_you:les|os}} proveerá ricamente la entrada en el reino eterno de nuestro Señor y Salvador {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Así es como se {{plural_you:les|os}} dará una bienvenida abundante y espléndida en el reino eterno de nuestro Señor y Salvador, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Entonces Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} recibirá con gran honor en el reino eterno de nuestro Señor y Salvador, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana hivyo ndivyo mtakavyopewa kwa wingi kuingia katika ufalme wa milele wa Bwana wetu na Mwokozi Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Hivyo ndivyo mtakavyokaribishwa kwa ukamilifu na kwa ukarimu mkubwa katika ufalme wa milele wa Bwana wetu na Mwokozi, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Ndipo Mungu atawakaribisha kwa heshima kubwa katika ufalme wa milele wa Bwana wetu na Mwokozi, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Car ainsi l’entrée dans le royaume éternel de notre Seigneur et Sauveur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} vous sera richement accordée.
fr.B: C’est ainsi que vous sera accordé un accueil large et généreux dans le royaume éternel de notre Seigneur et Sauveur, Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Alors Dieu vous accueillera avec de grands honneurs dans le royaume éternel de notre Seigneur et Sauveur, Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

ko.L: 이렇게 하여 우리 주 구주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영원한 나라에 들어가는 길이 여러분에게 넉넉히 마련될 것입니다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 여러분은 우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영원한 나라에 넉넉히 환영을 받으며 들어가게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 하나님께서 여러분을 우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영원한 나라로 큰 영광 가운데 맞아들이실 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì như vậy, anh chị em sẽ được ban cho dư dật sự vào vương quốc đời đời của Chúa và Cứu Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Như vậy anh chị em sẽ được đón tiếp cách trọng thể và rộng rãi vào vương quốc đời đời của Chúa và Cứu Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Chúa Trời sẽ đón tiếp anh chị em cách rất vinh dự vào vương quốc đời đời của Chúa và Cứu Chúa chúng ta, Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Pois assim lhes será ricamente suprida a entrada no Reino eterno do nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: É assim que vocês serão recebidos com uma acolhida plena e generosa no Reino eterno do nosso Senhor e Salvador, Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Então Deus vai receber vocês com grande honra no Reino eterno do nosso Senhor e Salvador, Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.

am.L: በዚህም ወደ ጌታችንና ወደ አዳኛችን ወደ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ዘላለማዊ መንግሥት መግባት በብዛት ይሰጣችኋልና።
am.B: በዚህ መንገድ ወደ ጌታችንና ወደ አዳኛችን ወደ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ዘላለማዊ መንግሥት ሙሉና የተትረፈረፈ አቀባበል ይደረግላችኋል።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጌታችንና ወደ አዳኛችን ወደ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ዘላለማዊ መንግሥት በታላቅ ክብር ይቀበላችኋል።

decisions.choice: will be richly supplied: God will give it generously
decisions.reason: ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται is the verb of 1:5: the readers are to supply goodness and the rest, and God will richly supply their entrance. The passive form leaves God as the giver.

decisions.choice: our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ: one person
decisions.reason: One article governs "Lord" and "Savior", the same pattern as "our God and Savior" in 1:1 (1:1 m3). Here no one doubts that both titles name Jesus Christ.

decisions.choice: the entrance into the eternal kingdom: entering the kingdom of Christ when he comes
decisions.reason: εἴσοδος is a way in, an entry. The kingdom is Christ's, and it lasts forever; the readers will enter it fully at his coming (1:16; 3:13). Some think of the welcome given to a victor returning home; the text itself says only that it will be rich.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: a full and generous welcome (B); God will welcome you with great honor (R)
alternatives: an entrance will be richly provided
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "welcome" for the entrance that is given, and Readable names God as the giver (m1).

source.text: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I will be about always you to remind concerning these things, although knowing and having been made firm in the present truth.

en.L: Therefore I will always be ready to remind you about these things, although you know [them] and have been made firm in the truth that is present [with you].
en.B: So I will keep on reminding you of these things, though you already know them and stand firm in the truth that has come to you.
en.R: That is why I will always remind you about these things. You already know them, and you are standing strong in the truth you have been given.

es.L: Por eso estaré siempre dispuesto a recordar{{plural_you:les|os}} estas cosas, aunque [las] {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} y {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido afianzados en la verdad que está presente [entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}].
es.B: Por eso seguiré recordándo{{plural_you:les|os}} estas cosas, aunque ya las {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} y {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en la verdad que {{plural_you:les|os}} ha llegado.
es.R: Por eso siempre {{plural_you:les|os}} recordaré estas cosas. {{plural_you:Ustedes ya las conocen|Vosotros ya las conocéis}}, y {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en la verdad que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} recibido.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitakuwa tayari siku zote kuwakumbusha kuhusu mambo haya, ingawa mnayajua na mmeimarishwa katika kweli iliyopo [kwenu].
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitaendelea kuwakumbusha mambo haya, ingawa tayari mnayajua na mnasimama imara katika kweli iliyowafikia.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu nitawakumbusha mambo haya siku zote. Tayari mnayajua, na mnasimama imara katika kweli mliyopewa.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je serai toujours prêt à vous rappeler ces choses, bien que vous [les] sachiez et que vous soyez affermis dans la vérité qui est présente [chez vous].
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je continuerai à vous rappeler ces choses, même si vous les savez déjà et que vous êtes bien affermis dans la vérité qui vous est parvenue.
fr.R: Voilà pourquoi je vous rappellerai toujours ces choses. Vous les savez déjà, et vous tenez bon dans la vérité que vous avez reçue.

ko.L: 그러므로 여러분이 이것들을 알고 있고, 여러분에게 있는 진리 안에 굳게 서 있지만, 나는 언제나 이것들에 대하여 여러분에게 일깨우려고 합니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 여러분이 이미 이것들을 알고 있고 여러분이 받은 진리 위에 굳게 서 있지만, 나는 계속해서 여러분에게 이것들을 일깨워 주려고 합니다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 언제나 여러분에게 이런 것들을 일깨워 줄 것입니다. 여러분은 이미 이것들을 알고 있고, 여러분이 받은 진리 위에 굳게 서 있습니다.

vi.L: Vì vậy tôi sẽ luôn sẵn sàng nhắc nhở anh chị em về những điều này, dù anh chị em đã biết [những điều ấy] và đã được làm cho vững vàng trong chân lý đang có [nơi anh chị em].
vi.B: Vì thế tôi sẽ tiếp tục nhắc nhở anh chị em về những điều này, dù anh chị em đã biết rồi và đang đứng vững trong chân lý đã đến với anh chị em.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi sẽ luôn nhắc nhở anh chị em về những điều này. Anh chị em đã biết những điều ấy rồi, và anh chị em đang đứng vững trong chân lý mà anh chị em đã nhận được.

pt.L: Por isso estarei sempre pronto a lembrá-los dessas coisas, embora [vocês as] saibam e tenham sido firmados na verdade que está presente [com vocês].
pt.B: Por isso vou continuar lembrando vocês dessas coisas, ainda que vocês já as saibam e estejam firmes na verdade que chegou até vocês.
pt.R: É por isso que sempre vou lembrar vocês dessas coisas. Vocês já sabem disso e estão firmes na verdade que receberam.

am.L: ስለዚህ ምንም እንኳ ብታውቁትና አሁን ባላችሁ እውነት የጸናችሁ ብትሆኑም ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች ዘወትር ላሳስባችሁ እዘጋጃለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ምንም እንኳ እነዚህን ነገሮች አስቀድማችሁ ብታውቁና ወደ እናንተ በመጣው እውነት ጸንታችሁ ብትቆሙም ዘወትር ማሳሰቤን አላቋርጥም።
am.R: ስለዚህ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች ሁልጊዜ አሳስባችኋለሁ። እናንተ አስቀድማችሁ ታውቋቸዋላችሁ፤ በተሰጣችሁም እውነት ጸንታችሁ ቆማችኋል።

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "I will be ready" (or "I will intend")
alternatives: "I will not neglect" to remind you
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "I will not neglect", a reading that differs by a few letters in Greek. The SBLGNT follows important early manuscripts with the unusual future form μελλήσω, which a copyist may have found hard and changed. The sense is much the same: Peter will keep on reminding them. Reviewers must check the evidence against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: I will be ready: I intend, and will be sure, to remind you
decisions.reason: μελλήσω is the future of a verb that means to intend or to be about to do something. Peter states his purpose, which the next verses explain: he expects to die soon (1:14) and wants the reminder to last (1:15).

decisions.choice: the truth that is present with you: the truth that has come to you and that you now hold
alternatives: the truth of the present time
decisions.reason: παρούσῃ means present, having arrived. Colossians 1:5-6 uses the same verb of the gospel "which has come to you". The readers have the truth already; Peter reminds them so they keep it.

source.text: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι, ἐφ’ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι, διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει, εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου, καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι·

records.literal_gloss: Right and I consider [it], as long as I am in this the tent, to stir up you by reminder, \v 14 knowing that soon is the putting off of the tent of me, just as also the Lord of us Jesus Christ showed to me;

en.L: And I consider [it] right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by a reminder, \v 14 knowing that the putting off of my tent is soon, just as our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} also showed me.
en.B: While I still live in this tent of a body, I think it right to keep you awake by reminding you, \v 14 because I know that I must soon lay this tent aside, as our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has shown me.
en.R: I think it is right to keep waking you up with reminders as long as I am alive in this body, the tent I live in for now. \v 14 I know that I will soon have to leave this tent and die. Our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} showed me this.

es.L: Y considero justo, mientras estoy en esta tienda, despertar{{plural_you:los|os}} con [el] recuerdo, \v 14 sabiendo que pronto [viene] el despojarme de mi tienda, como también nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} me [lo] mostró.
es.B: Mientras viva aún en esta tienda que es el cuerpo, considero justo mantener{{plural_you:los|os}} despiertos con mis recordatorios, \v 14 porque sé que pronto he de dejar a un lado esta tienda, como nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} me ha mostrado.
es.R: Me parece bien seguir despertándo{{plural_you:los|os}} con recordatorios mientras esté vivo en este cuerpo, la tienda en que vivo por ahora. \v 14 Sé que pronto tendré que dejar esta tienda y morir. Nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} me lo mostró.

sw.L: Na ninaona ni haki, maadamu bado niko katika hema hii, kuwaamsha kwa ukumbusho, \v 14 nikifahamu kwamba kuivua hema yangu ni karibu, kama vile Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyonidhihirishia.
sw.B: Maadamu bado ninaishi katika hema hii ya mwili, naona ni haki kuwaweka macho kwa kuwakumbusha, \v 14 kwa sababu najua kwamba karibuni lazima niiweke kando hema hii, kama Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyonionyesha.
sw.R: Naona ni vema kuendelea kuwaamsha kwa kuwakumbusha mambo haya maadamu niko hai katika mwili huu, hema ninayoishi ndani yake kwa sasa. \v 14 Najua kwamba hivi karibuni nitaiacha hema hii na kufa. Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alinionyesha jambo hili.

fr.L: Et j’estime juste, aussi longtemps que je suis dans cette tente, de vous tenir en éveil par un rappel, \v 14 sachant que le dépouillement de ma tente est proche, comme aussi notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} me l’a montré.
fr.B: Tant que je vis encore dans cette tente qu’est mon corps, j’estime qu’il est juste de vous tenir en éveil en vous rappelant ces choses, \v 14 car je sais que je dois bientôt quitter cette tente, comme notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} me l’a fait savoir.
fr.R: Je pense qu’il est juste de continuer à vous réveiller par des rappels, aussi longtemps que je suis vivant dans ce corps, la tente où j’habite pour le moment. \v 14 Je sais que je devrai bientôt quitter cette tente et mourir. Notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} me l’a montré.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 이 장막에 있는 동안, 일깨움으로 여러분을 깨우는 것이 옳다고 생각합니다. \v 14 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 나에게 보여 주신 것처럼, 내 장막을 벗을 때가 곧 온다는 것을 알기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나는 이 몸의 장막에 머물러 있는 동안, 여러분에게 일깨워 주어 여러분을 깨어 있게 하는 것이 옳다고 생각합니다. \v 14 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 나에게 보여 주신 대로, 나는 이 장막을 곧 벗어야 한다는 것을 알기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 나는 지금 이 몸, 곧 잠시 머무는 천막 안에서 살고 있습니다. 내가 살아 있는 동안, 여러분에게 이런 것들을 일깨워 주어 여러분을 깨어 있게 하는 것이 옳다고 생각합니다. \v 14 나는 곧 이 천막을 떠나 죽게 될 것을 압니다. 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 나에게 이것을 보여 주셨습니다.

vi.L: Và tôi nghĩ là phải lẽ, bao lâu tôi còn ở trong cái lều này, thì nhắc nhở để thức tỉnh anh chị em, \v 14 vì biết rằng việc tôi cởi bỏ cái lều của mình đã gần kề, như Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} cũng đã cho tôi biết.
vi.B: Bao lâu tôi còn sống trong cái lều là thân xác này, tôi nghĩ là phải giữ cho anh chị em tỉnh thức bằng cách nhắc nhở anh chị em, \v 14 vì tôi biết rằng chẳng bao lâu nữa tôi phải rời bỏ cái lều này, như Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đã cho tôi biết.
vi.R: Tôi nghĩ là phải tiếp tục đánh thức anh chị em bằng những lời nhắc nhở, bao lâu tôi còn sống trong thân xác này, là cái lều tôi tạm ở. \v 14 Tôi biết rằng chẳng bao lâu nữa tôi sẽ phải rời bỏ cái lều này mà chết. Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đã cho tôi biết điều đó.

pt.L: E considero justo, enquanto estou nesta tenda, despertá-los com uma lembrança, \v 14 sabendo que a remoção da minha tenda está próxima, como também o nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} me mostrou.
pt.B: Enquanto ainda vivo nesta tenda que é o corpo, considero justo manter vocês despertos com lembranças, \v 14 porque sei que em breve vou deixar de lado esta tenda, como o nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} me mostrou.
pt.R: Acho certo continuar despertando vocês com lembretes enquanto eu estiver vivo neste corpo, a tenda em que moro por enquanto. \v 14 Sei que logo vou ter de deixar esta tenda e morrer. O nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} me mostrou isso.

am.L: በዚህ ድንኳን እስካለሁ ድረስ በማሳሰብ ላነቃችሁ ተገቢ እንደ ሆነ እቆጥራለሁ፤ \v 14 ጌታችን ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ደግሞ እንደ ገለጠልኝ ድንኳኔን የማስወግድበት ጊዜ ቅርብ እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁና።
am.B: በዚህ ድንኳን፣ በአካሌ፣ ገና እስካለሁ ድረስ በማሳሰብ ማንቃታችሁ ተገቢ እንደ ሆነ አስባለሁ፤ \v 14 ጌታችን ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንዳሳየኝ ይህን ድንኳን በቅርቡ እንደማስወግደው አውቃለሁና።
am.R: በዚህ ሰውነት፣ ለጊዜው በምኖርበት ድንኳን፣ በሕይወት እስካለሁ ድረስ እያሳሰብኳችሁ ማንቃቴን መቀጠል ትክክል እንደ ሆነ አስባለሁ። \v 14 ይህን ድንኳን በቅርቡ ትቼ እንደምሞት አውቃለሁ። ጌታችን ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ይህን አሳይቶኛል።

decisions.choice: this tent: the body; the putting off of the tent: death
decisions.reason: A tent is a dwelling for a short stay. Paul uses the same picture of the body in 2 Corinthians 5:1-4. ἀπόθεσις means a taking off or laying aside, as of clothing or a tent taken down.

decisions.choice: the Lord showed me: Jesus told Peter how he would die
alternatives: a later revelation to Peter not recorded elsewhere
decisions.reason: John 21:18-19 records Jesus telling Peter that when he was old others would lead him where he did not want to go, "to show by what death he would glorify God". That is the most likely reference, though Peter may also mean a later word from the Lord.

decisions.choice: soon: near at hand
decisions.reason: ταχινή can mean coming soon or coming swiftly. In 2:1 the same word describes the swift destruction of the false teachers. Here Peter is explaining why he writes now, so "soon" fits best.

decisions.choice: stir up: rouse, wake up
decisions.reason: διεγείρειν means to wake someone from sleep (Mark 4:38-39). Peter wants to keep the readers alert; 3:1 repeats the same words.

decisions.choice: Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: this tent of a body (B); in this body, the tent I live in for now; leave this tent and die (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the tent stands for (m1). Literal keeps the picture alone.

decisions.choice: tienda
decisions.reason: "Tabernáculo", the word of older Spanish Bibles, now suggests the sanctuary in the wilderness or a church fitting. "Tienda" keeps the plain picture of a tent, a dwelling for a short stay (m1).

decisions.choice: hema; kuivua hema
decisions.reason: "Hema" is a tent, which keeps Peter's picture of the body as a dwelling for a short stay (m1); "maskani" is any dwelling. Literal says "kuivua", taking off as one takes off clothing, for ἀπόθεσις.

decisions.choice: "장막" (L, B); "천막" (R) for the tent of the body; "장막을 벗다" for death
decisions.reason: The tent is the body, and putting it off is death (meaning decision). Korean "장막" keeps the picture at Literal and Balanced, and Balanced adds "몸의"; Readable uses the everyday "천막" and says plainly that Peter will die, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "cái lều" for the tent at every level
decisions.reason: The tent is the body, and putting it off is death (m1). "Cái lều" keeps Peter's everyday picture of a dwelling taken down when one moves on; "đền tạm" would make it the tabernacle of worship.

decisions.choice: ድንኳን (tent) for the body, kept at every level
decisions.reason: Peter pictures his body as a tent that will be taken down at death (m1); the picture is clear in Amharic, so Balanced and Readable keep it and add the body beside it, as the English does.

source.text: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: I will be diligent and also at every time to have you after the my departure the of these things remembrance to make.

en.L: And I will also be diligent that at every time after my departure you may be able to call these things to mind.
en.B: And I will see to it that after I am gone you will be able to recall these things whenever you need them.
en.R: I will do my best to make sure that you can always remember these things, even after I am gone.

es.L: Y también me esforzaré para que en todo momento, después de mi partida, {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} hacer memoria de estas cosas.
es.B: Y me ocuparé de que, cuando ya no esté, {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} recordar estas cosas siempre que lo {{plural_you:necesiten|necesitéis}}.
es.R: Haré todo lo posible para que siempre {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} recordar estas cosas, aun después de que yo me haya ido.

sw.L: Tena nitafanya bidii ili wakati wowote, baada ya kuondoka kwangu, mpate kuwa na uwezo wa kuyakumbuka mambo haya.
sw.B: Nami nitahakikisha kwamba baada ya mimi kuondoka, mtaweza kuyakumbuka mambo haya wakati wowote mtakapoyahitaji.
sw.R: Nitafanya kila niwezalo ili mweze kuyakumbuka mambo haya siku zote, hata baada ya mimi kuondoka.

fr.L: Et je m’efforcerai aussi qu’en tout temps, après mon départ, vous puissiez vous souvenir de ces choses.
fr.B: Et je ferai en sorte qu’après mon départ vous puissiez vous rappeler ces choses chaque fois que vous en aurez besoin.
fr.R: Je ferai tout mon possible pour que vous puissiez toujours vous souvenir de ces choses, même quand je ne serai plus là.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 내가 떠난 뒤에도 여러분이 언제든지 이것들을 기억할 수 있도록 힘쓰겠습니다.
ko.B: 그리고 내가 세상을 떠난 뒤에도, 여러분이 필요할 때마다 이것들을 기억할 수 있도록 힘쓰겠습니다.
ko.R: 내가 세상을 떠난 뒤에도 여러분이 언제나 이것들을 기억할 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.

vi.L: Và tôi cũng sẽ chuyên cần để sau khi tôi ra đi, anh chị em luôn luôn có thể nhớ lại những điều này.
vi.B: Tôi cũng sẽ lo liệu để sau khi tôi đi rồi, anh chị em vẫn có thể nhớ lại những điều này bất cứ lúc nào cần.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức để anh chị em luôn nhớ những điều này, ngay cả sau khi tôi đã qua đời.

pt.L: E também me esforçarei para que, a todo momento, depois da minha partida, vocês possam trazer essas coisas à memória.
pt.B: E vou cuidar para que, depois que eu tiver partido, vocês possam se lembrar dessas coisas sempre que precisarem.
pt.R: Vou fazer o possível para que vocês sempre possam se lembrar dessas coisas, mesmo depois que eu tiver partido.

am.L: ከመሄዴም በኋላ እነዚህን ነገሮች በማንኛውም ጊዜ እንድታስቡ እተጋለሁ።
